item.title: Former Hanover elementary school bookkeeper to serve prison time for embezzling $35,000 from school
item.description: A former bookkeeper at Beaverdam Elementary School in Hanover County will serve prison time after being convicted of embezzlement for stealing $35,000 from the school.

item.title: 'My brother was our everything': Henrico police search for suspect in Richmond man's murder
item.description: Henrico police are searching for a man wanted in connection with the murder of 38-year-old Darryl Hines, who was found shot to death on January 8.

item.title: Tracey puts up 26 as VCU knocks off Dayton 99-73
item.description: Jadrian Tracey's 26 points helped VCU defeat Dayton 99-73 on Friday night. Tracey shot 9 for 12 (6 for 9 from 3-point range) for the Rams (18-6, 9-2 Atlantic 10 Conference).
